summary: 发票实现首片（invoicing 插件，按 ADR 0015）：新建 pmo_plugins/invoicing 插件（manifest 8 字段、requires contracts/settlement/cash/management_revenue/costing、自有迁移 0001、domain_metadata canonical 路由、delivery urls root 单写绑定），实现 Invoice/InvoiceLine/InvoiceAllocation/InvoiceReversal/TaxQualification 五个 owned fact 模型与 vendor-aware append-only 触发器（PG 函数 + SQLite 触发器；仅 Invoice 允许 active→reversed 状态位，其余 UPDATE/DELETE 拒绝）。服务层 record_invoice/allocate_invoice_lines/reverse_invoice：公司锁、request_token 审计收据幂等、期间/锁期、整数分 gross=net+tax、行合计=头、分配合计=行、业务来源（合同批准明细/结算未清项/结算）同 org/同往来方/额度只读派生、部分红冲保 active、全额→reversed、append-only 负值冲销、红票≠退款；不写收入/现金/账本/未清。浏览器列表/详情/登记/分配/红冲表单走具名服务；verify_integrity 新增发票分支（头行合计、分配守恒与来源、红冲 signed/状态机、规范事件、无财务事件/来源消费）；generic audit + canonical DomainEvent（recorded/lines_allocated/reversed）。默认启用（default_enabled=True，符合 ADR 0010）；因新增对 contracts/settlement/cash/management_revenue/costing 的依赖，既有 22 个白名单外测试文件在“直接停用依赖模块”时被依赖守卫拒绝，需规划槽补测试白名单后显式先停用 invoicing；停用后 history_read 历史只读。

review.reviewer: independent PH-252 invoicing first-slice reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the new plugin is disabled by default against the ownership decision: `pmo_plugins/invoicing/plugin.py` sets `default_enabled=False`, while ADR 0010 explicitly freezes the invoicing manifest with `default_enabled=True` (and every other first-class business plugin is default-enabled). With no PluginState row, `is_enabled` therefore blocks all invoice writes and the form/record/allocate/reverse routes in a fresh company; the candidate only bypasses this by calling `set_enabled` in the test fixture. Fix: set `default_enabled=True` (keep the disabled-module history-read and write-denial tests by explicitly disabling the plugin in those tests), or obtain an explicit product decision/ADR change for an opt-in default.

BLOCKER - partial reversal does not enforce per-line/per-allocation limits: `reverse_invoice` validates only the aggregate `abs(total_gross) <= remaining` plus total tax split; supplied `line_reversals` are trusted without checking each line's remaining (and `allocation_reversals` are not checked against existing allocations at all). A caller can reverse the entire remaining amount against one line while leaving another line untouched, or reference a foreign/over-amount allocation, and the aggregate check still passes. ADR 0015 requires each line/allocation not to exceed its un-reversed amount. Fix: validate each `line_reversals.original_line_ref` belongs to this invoice and its amount <= that line's remaining (and same for allocations/source refs), add regression cases for over-line/foreign-allocation rejection, and have the verifier cross-check line/allocation reversal totals.

BLOCKER - TaxQualification has no database append-only guard: the migration installs PG functions/triggers and SQLite triggers for Invoice/InvoiceLine/InvoiceAllocation/InvoiceReversal, but not for `invoicing_taxqualification`; only the model `save/delete` guard protects it. The frozen append-only fact contract (and the task's DB-level immutable-history requirement) is therefore bypassable by direct UPDATE/DELETE for an invoicing fact. Fix: add the vendor-aware guard/trigger (and a probe test) for TaxQualification, or explicitly scope it out of DB-level append-only with a documented follow-up.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: integer-cent gross=net+tax on header/line/allocation/reversal, line total=header, allocation total=line, ROUND_HALF_UP last-item split is exercised by the service; Invoice status active->reversed only (partial keeps active) with model guard and PG/SQLite triggers for the main facts; company lock, request_token replay/changed-input conflict, expected_version, period/locked/closed rejection, source quota, and no revenue/cash/ledger/income writes are covered; verify_integrity has invoice header/line/allocation/source/reversal/status/event/financial-event/source-consumption branches and the malformed-header probe raises; canonical domain_metadata history_read routes + delivery urls import-only; default-disabled history read is intact. 23 changed files within the 24-path PH-252 allowed_paths; no core migration (invoicing 0001 leaf). check ok=250; makemigrations clean; scoped 15 OK; full 1140/5F+3E/69 known baseline; fresh verify_integrity ok; verify-change --base 2659317 --task PH-252 only high_risk_review_required, no path_out_of_scope. deviations: Reverse is implemented in this slice (InvoiceReversal + reverse_invoice + verify branch) per the Lead task instruction and ADR 0015; the older PH-252 spec text said reversal was deferred, but ADR 0015 freezes invoicing.invoice.reverse/v1 and the Lead explicitly required record/allocate/reverse. No posted/superseded status is produced.

Reviewer round-1 blocker 1 fix: default_enabled=True per ADR 0010. This creates a reverse dependency on contracts/settlement/cash/management_revenue/costing, so 22 existing test files that disable a dependency module without first disabling invoicing now fail the dependency guard (exact list in the review note); the PH-252 whitelist does not include those test files, so the required explicit set_enabled(false) updates need a planning-slot whitelist expansion (PH-269/274 precedent). No self-expansion was performed.

Reviewer round-1 blocker 2 fix: reverse_invoice now validates every line_reversal reference belongs to the invoice and stays within that line's remaining amount, every allocation_reversal reference/line/business-source belongs to the invoice and stays within that allocation's remaining amount, and line vs allocation reversal totals must match; over-line and foreign-allocation regressions were added, and verify_integrity cross-checks line/allocation detail totals and cumulative reversals.

Reviewer round-1 blocker 3 fix: the migration now installs vendor-aware append-only triggers (PG function + SQLite update/delete triggers) on invoicing_taxqualification as well, and a regression proves direct UPDATE/DELETE are rejected.

request_token receipts are stored in generic AuditEvent payload (request_token/input_digest/result) rather than a new receipt table, matching the spec's five-model list and avoiding an extra table; replay/changed-input semantics are covered by tests.

Business-source allocation first slice supports contract approved lines, settlement open items and settlement sources (sales direction only); purchase invoice allocation to other source kinds and service/acceptance sources are rejected as unsupported rather than guessed, to be extended by a later slice.

TaxQualification model is created per ADR/spec but no qualification write service/UI is exposed in this slice (ADR leaves qualification confirmation to a later slice); tax treatment remains a snapshot fact only.

The plugin requires all five owner plugins in its manifest (per ADR 0015) but its migration_dependencies are core/contracts/settlement to keep the migration graph acyclic; cash/management_revenue/costing are runtime read dependencies.

No core model/migration is modified; invoicing owns its own migration chain (0001_initial) and root-only files (settings, delivery urls, verify_integrity, governance) are the integrator-owned wiring explicitly allowed by the spec.
Counterexamples/tests never UPDATE/DELETE historical rows through supported paths; DB triggers and model guards are asserted with savepoint-contained IntegrityError checks.
